summary: Completed testing of 9 user findings for iteration 12. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI verified: Dashboard shows real data with date range, cosmo_route_id visible in journey detail, driver name in subtitle, Kosmo sync bar shows correct text, sync button returns 'started', odometer validation shows error toast, Intentos column visible in packages table.

Finding_1_Delivery_Attempt_Counting.details: delivery_attempt field computed dynamically via aggregation pipeline. Packages sorted by date ascending, then reverse numbered (newest=1, oldest=highest). All current packages show attempt=1 since no duplicate order_reference_ids exist across routes.

Finding_2_Cosmo_Route_ID_Visible.details: Journey detail page shows cosmo_route_id 'MX-X8FyHytJMU' next to status badge. Verified via UI screenshot.

Finding_3_Dashboard_Real_Data_With_Date_.details: Dashboard cards show real data: RUTAS ACTIVAS=1, PAQUETES ENTREGADOS=4/61, INCIDENCIAS ABIERTAS=0. GET /api/dashboard/stats accepts date_from and date_to parameters.

Finding_4_Date_Filter_Off_By_One_Fix.details: GET /api/journeys with date_from=2026-03-24&date_to=2026-03-24 returns journeys with timestamps like '2026-03-24 16:47:36'. Uses _next_day() helper to convert date_to to next day for $lt comparison.

Finding_5_WhatsApp_Close_Summary.details: generateWhatsAppCloseSummary includes driver name (line 184) and attempt rate (line 192: 'Reintentos: X paquetes (Y%)'). Code verified in /app/frontend/src/lib/utils.js.

Finding_6_Odometer_End_Validation.details: Close route form shows error toast 'Ingresa el odómetro final antes de cerrar la ruta' when odometer_end is empty. Verified via UI screenshot.

Finding_7_Evidence_Scoring_Failed_Packag.details: evidence_scoring.py lines 73-105: failed packages require photo+note for score 100, photo only=60, note only=40, neither=0. Unit test verified all cases.

Finding_8_API_Docs_Updated.details: GET /api/reports/schema includes: resolve-all endpoint (line 2996), review endpoint (line 3006), sync/tracking endpoint (line 2932), packages report includes reviewed_by/reviewed_at fields (line 2866).

Finding_9_Sync_Tracking_Async.details: POST /api/sync/tracking returns {status: 'started'} immediately. Dashboard shows 'Sincronización iniciada en segundo plano' toast. Kosmo sync bar shows 'Sincronización Kosmo (cada 10 min)' with actual counts.

resolve_all_incidents_endpoint.details: PUT /api/incidents/journey/{journey_id}/resolve-all works correctly. Requires coordinator/agent role (not developer).

review_package_endpoint.details: PUT /api/packages/{package_id}/review marks package as reviewed with reviewed_by and reviewed_at fields.

intentos_column_in_packages_table.details: Packages table in journey detail has 'INTENTOS' column between EVIDENCIAS and REVISADO columns.

driver_name_in_journey_subtitle.details: Journey detail subtitle shows 'JORGE OMAR PEREZ ALEMAN • Chamedé Logistics • Cubbo' with driver name first.
